info.description:
Authentication boilerplate API: register, login, token refresh, sessions, email verification and password reset.
Successful and failed responses share one envelope: {code, message, data, error, errors, serverTime}.
info.title: Go Auth System API

get.description: Reports whether the service can reach its database. This endpoint does not use the standard response envelope.

BearerAuth.description: Type "Bearer", a space, then the access token from /auth/login. Note: after calling /auth/login on this page the browser also stores the access_token cookie, which protected endpoints accept when no Authorization header is sent.
BearerAuth.name: Authorization
